risks.reviewFocus: Local/BYOK/Managed labels, explicit forks, no silent routing across trust boundaries. Desktop egress guard (egressGuard.ts) is FETCH-ONLY: JS our-cloud fetches must use guardedFetch (eslint-enforced for WEB_APP_URL/API_BASE_URL templates). KNOWN GAP (2026-06-24): Rust-transport egress is NOT covered by the JS guard — sys/account device/profile/credit Tauri commands reqwest www.agiworkforce.com with the Bearer token and no privacy-mode gate, and fire in BYOK (signed-in cloud session). Open decision: is BYOK account-management intended to reach AGI cloud (then correct the egressGuard 'never account data' docstring) or must it be gated Rust-side (then mirror the guard). Do not route chat/file/session payloads on any ungated transport.
No hardcoded model IDs; provider capability metadata owns routing decisions

Tenant isolation, admin policy defaults, SSO/SCIM data ownership, support privacy labels, managed-credit public launch gates. KNOWN GAP (verified 2026-06-24): audit immutability is NOT enforced — public.security_audit_logs (0014_security.sql) has no REVOKE or trigger, so the app role app_rls can UPDATE/DELETE rows freely. Correct fix is non-trivial: cleanup_old_security_logs (90-day retention) and the GDPR user-purge (0020_functions.sql) are NOT security definer, so a plain REVOKE would break retention + compliance; the migration must make those 2 functions security definer (with injection review) THEN REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE FROM app_rls, and be DB-verified before apply. See known-flaws AUDIT-IMMUT-01.
